user_story: As a user of the application, I want to interact with JavaScript alert dialogs so that I can see how alerts, confirms, and prompts work. Acceptance Criteria: When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Alert', a JavaScript alert should appear. When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Confirm', a JavaScript confirm should appear. When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Prompt', a JavaScript prompt should appear. The result of the last interaction should be displayed in the element with id 'result'.
